name: edu
description: Initialize course and group-project workspaces, keep project methods within the course scope unless explicitly approved, and teach from course materials with paced explanations and interactive practice.

interface.shortDescription: 课程与小组项目初始化、逐页教学与互动练习
interface.longDescription: Edu-Init 建立课程学习规则；Edu-GroupProject-Init 支持在课程内新建项目子目录或直接初始化已有项目，整理原始资料、过程资料和提交内容，并规定超纲部分须先获得明确同意；Edu-Teaching 对照原始课件逐页讲解，使用中文解释、英文术语、小例子、过程图示和单题理解检查。
